analysis.summary: The PR introduces inconsistent path configurations between the BFF API, CloudFront behaviors, and S3 asset deployment, alongside breaking changes to CloudFront URI rewrites.

bugs.title: Inconsistent baseUrl calculation between Site and BffApi
bugs.description: In Site.ts, baseUrl is calculated using app.name, while BffApi.ts and Webpack configurations use featureAppName from AppConfig. If app.name (SST project name) differs from featureAppName, CloudFront routing and S3 asset lookups will fail.
bugs.risk: Requests to the BFF and static assets will result in 404 errors because the CloudFront behavior path (using app.name) will not match the API Gateway routes or the S3 folder structure (using featureAppName).

bugs.title: Missing index.html and pretty URL rewrites
bugs.description: The removal of cfFunction from the CloudFront distribution removes the logic that appends index.html to directory requests and .html to clean URLs. The replacement edgeLambdas are only applied to a fallback behavior, not the primary S3 behaviors.
bugs.risk: Users navigating to the root domain or direct page URLs (e.g., /my-page) will receive 403 Access Denied or 404 Not Found errors from S3, as CloudFront no longer rewrites these to the corresponding .html files.

bugs.title: BFF Route mismatch in API Gateway
bugs.description: The API Gateway route is updated to include the full baseUrl prefix. However, if the underlying Lambda handler (src/bff/index.handler) is not updated to expect or strip this prefix, it may fail to match internal tRPC or Express routes.
bugs.risk: Even if routing matches at the API Gateway level, the internal application logic will likely fail to process requests because the path received by the handler now contains a nested prefix (/__app__/.../bff) instead of starting at the expected /bff root.

notBugs.reason: This is consistent with the infrastructure change where the BFF API route now explicitly includes the baseUrl prefix; stripping it locally would cause a mismatch with the updated remote environment.
